data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate's gross claims outstanding at 1 January 2024 was GBP 315.080m. During 2024 there was no material overall movement in prior years' gross claims provisions (net movement approximately nil), leaving the prior-year position effectively flat. The report comments on a number of named catastrophe events (e.g. Maui fires, Los Angeles wildfires and US Midwest hail/tornado activity) and notes longer-term pressures such as litigation funding/social inflation in liability classes, but overall the gross prior-year reserve position did not show a net strengthening or release in the reconciliation presented.

data.data_quality_notes: Opening gross claims outstanding taken from the Balance Sheet (liabilities) prior-year comparative column (explicit). Prior-year development derived from the technical provisions reconciliation table (movement in claims outstanding) which shows no net change in the 'change in estimates of prior year provisions' line (gross). Claims development triangle is present in the notes but not fully transcribed here; there is some discussion of RITC activity historically which can distort development tables for closed years (users should cross-check triangle if a granular PYD is required). Named events and causal phrases were extracted from the Managing Agent/Underwriter commentary; amounts for individual events are not quantified in the notes provided.
